summary: A Walker County High Point on Georgia's tower list (gfc-707, 2,327 ft); no build, staffing or current-condition source found.

evidence.supports: Georgia lookout towers list: Walker County High Point at 2,327 ft, note lookout mtn, number gfc-707
The list's title is Georgia lookout towers
The Chattooga County High Point tower is a separate entry, numbered gfc-702
The Forest Lookouts High Point page covers Chattooga County
The Chattooga tower was constructed in 1956 as described on the page
evidence.quote: This fire tower was constructed in 1956

evidence.supports: Steel tower with six-by-six-foot metal cab, 60 feet tall (Chattooga tower)
evidence.quote: The steel tower had a six foot by six foot metal cab and is 60 feet in height.

corrections.why: The 18.3 m (60 ft) height matches the Chattooga County High Point tower described on the Forest Lookouts page. No source gives a height for the Walker County site.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only a state list line gives this Walker County site (gfc-707, 2,327 ft, note lookout mtn). The record's 18.3 m height matches the Chattooga County tower, so it was probably copied from us-ga-high-point. A WebSearch found a Walker County wildfire on Lookout Mountain that damaged a radio tower; the reports do not name this site, so it is left out. Needs GFC records or a local source before any build date, staffing or fire history is written. Not verified on site.
